title: Desktop background: six dark styles, new one every 3 hours
objective: Replace the white i3 root window with a dark, text-free background that changes every 3 hours to a random style different from the previous one on that monitor and from the other monitor's.
acceptance_criteria: Six styles (gradient, procedural, heatmap, clock, earth, plasma) render the exact output size with mean brightness below 80/255
plan() rotates after 3 h to styles unlike each monitor's previous and unlike each other; inside 3 h static styles stay, live styles redraw, a lost root pixmap repaints
install_wallpaper_rotator.sh leaves wallpaper-rotator.timer enabled and active and paints once
